title: fix(app-shell): record pages and sealed managed apps get no navigation writes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbM4E3JW8kr9W6U2A9dehyRU)_

Fixes #29182

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：新建页面首次发布时，只有「不需要记录就能打开」的页面才写进各应用导航；记录页（`type: 'record'`）不再写。由托管包提供、被服务端封存的应用（如 showcase 的 `showcase_app`）不再被写导航，也就不再弹红色「Failed to update navigation」。
- **为什么改**：管理员每建一个记录页，控制台就往每个应用的导航里加一个打不开的入口（没有记录 id），并且对封存应用的写入被 403 拒绝、每次都弹错误提示。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 `useNavigationSync.ts` 的两处判断；「全部发布」路径无页面正文时按名读一次页面类型，读失败则不写导航并提示。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavigationSync.ts`（`isNavigationSyncableApp` 的 `_provenance` 行、`useNavigationWrites().created` 的页面分支），`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useNavigationSync.test.tsx` 末尾的新 describe。
- **两分钟验证**：showcase 上在 Studio 新建 `record` 类型页面并发布：网络面板里发布后没有任何 `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/*`，也没有红色提示；改建 `home` 类型页面，只写运行时创建的应用。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavigationSync.ts`, per the seat's rulings on #29182:

1. **A page that needs a record is never synced into navigation.** `useNavigationWrites().created` now asks `isNavigablePage(body)` before `syncPageCreatedAllApps`. The page type comes from the body the create already holds (`ResourceEditPage` passes the published `lay.effective`). A body that leaves `type` out counts as a record page, because `PageSchema` declares `type` with the default `PAGE_TYPE_DEFAULT = 'record'`.
   - **Publish all** (`usePublishAllDrafts`) holds only the `_drafts` header rows, so no body reaches `created()`. For that caller only, the door reads the page by name once (`client.meta.getItem('page', name)`, one read per created page). If that read fails, the navigation write for that page is **skipped, not written blind**, and the existing "Failed to update navigation" toast says navigation was not updated. The seat amended the claim to add the Publish-all test file to the surface for this.
2. **A sealed app is not syncable.** `isNavigationSyncableApp` also returns `false` for an app whose read carries `_provenance: 'package'`. `app` has no per-org overlay channel (`allowEnvironmentOverlay: false`), so the server refuses every package-less write onto an artifact-backed app with `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` whatever its lock. The marker was measured on the stock showcase (below). Because the read carries a marker, the `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` fallback branch of the ruling is not needed and not added. Any other app-write failure still shows today's error toast.
3. Ruling A of #28680 stands: a navigable page is still written into every app that can take it, at create time.

No metadata key, no server change, no new gate. `isNavigationSyncableApp` is not exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`'s entry, and its signature is unchanged.

### Non-navigable page types found

`PageTypeSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`, the enum at `PageTypeSchema`) has five members: `record`, `home`, `app`, `utility`, `list`. Only `record` cannot render without a record:

- `record`: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/nav-target.ts`, `isStaticPageOption` docblock: "Record-detail pages (`type: 'record'`) require a specific record id to render, but a `type: 'page'` nav item resolves to a static `/apps/{app}/page/{name}` URL with no mechanism to pass one". Also `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`, `checkPageRecordBindingPlacement` docblock: "A record page already has its row — the record it opens".
- A body with no `type`: `packages/spec/src/ui/default-record-page.ts`, `PAGE_TYPE_DEFAULT` docblock: "a page authored without `type` IS a record page, and an unparsed body … that leaves the key out is judged as one".
- `home`, `list`, `utility` render without one (same `checkPageRecordBindingPlacement` docblock: they are "not about a row at all"). `app` resolves its own row from its optional `record` query binding, so it does not need one from the route either.

### The sealed-app marker, measured

Stock showcase boot at this branch's head (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`), `GET /api/v1/meta/app`, private keys per app:

| app | served keys | package-less `PUT` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `showcase_app` | `_packageId: com.example.showcase`, `_provenance: package` (no `_lock`) | `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` ("provided by a managed package and is sealed") |
| `setup`, `account` | `_provenance: package`, `_lock: full` | (already skipped by the lock) |
| `probe_app` (package-less, created by PUT) | none | 200 |
| `rthree_app` (app of a package created at runtime, `POST /api/v1/packages`) | `_packageId: com.probe.rthree` only | 200 |

So `_provenance` is the discriminator. `_packageId` is not, because a runtime package's app carries it and takes the write.

## Tests

- `useNavigationSync.test.tsx`: new `isNavigablePage` units, two new `isNavigationSyncableApp` units, and a new `describe` on the door: a record page (and a type-less body) writes no app and shows no toast; `home` and `list` pages still write every syncable app; with no body held the page is read by name and its type decides; a failed read writes nothing and toasts once; a sealed app gets no write and no red toast on create, dashboard create and delete; another app's write failure (500) still toasts. Existing door cases now pass an `app` page body.
- `usePublishAllDrafts.navigationWrites-28680.test.tsx` (surface amended by the seat): the adapter mock gains `getItem`. New case: Publish all with a new record page and a new `home` page writes only the `home` page, with exactly one by-name read per created page.
- `useNavigationSync.labelInherits-9868.test.tsx`: its page body now states `type: 'app'`. A type-less body is a record page, so it no longer writes. That is the behaviour this PR asks for.

<details><summary>Test runs (head 92a066d9)</summary>

- Touched files: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run useNavigationSync.test.tsx usePublishAllDrafts.navigationWrites-28680.test.tsx`: Test Files 2 passed, Tests 30 passed.
- Every ui test naming `useNavigationSync`, `useNavigationWrites` or `isNavigationSyncableApp` (9 files): Test Files 9 passed, Tests 77 passed.
- Every ui test naming `usePublishAllDrafts` or `publishAll`, plus every `ResourceEditPage*.test.tsx` (76 files): Test Files 76 passed, Tests 419 passed.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 65/65 tasks successful.
- After merging `origin/main` (36 commits, none on the touched files), on head `3c9ee893`: every ui test naming `useNavigationSync`, `useNavigationWrites`, `isNavigationSyncableApp` or `usePublishAllDrafts` (33 files): Test Files 33 passed, Tests 277 passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 34 families)</summary>

All 34 exit 0 on head `92a066d9`, reconciled with `dispatch-gates --ran`: "34 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: Test Files 169 passed, 2 skipped. Re-run on the merged head `3c9ee893`: `check-sdui-manifest`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check:nul-bytes`, all exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each committed first, run through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

- Record-page guard `if (!isNavigablePage(body)) return;` made always-pass: 3 cases red (record page writes no app; by-name read decides; Publish all record page).
- Sealed-app line `if (a._provenance === 'package') return false;` neutralised: 2 cases red (the unit; the door's sealed-app case).
- Failed-read branch `if (body === undefined) {` disabled: 1 case red (the failed read toasts).

Each restore read back as the HEAD blob `06b76092f89a` with an empty `git diff HEAD`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- A failed by-name page read (Publish all only) skips that page's navigation write and shows "Failed to update navigation". It does not write blind.
- Apps written by an earlier record-page create keep their stray entries. This PR stops new ones and does not clean up old ones. Deleting the page still removes its entries, as before.

## Verification

Card steps on a stock showcase (`examples/app-showcase`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`), Console from source (Vite, `@object-ui/*` src-aliased), Playwright. Studio `/studio/~all/metadata/page/new`, Object `showcase_task`, Save, then Publish. Apps present: `showcase_app`, `setup`, `account`, and the two runtime apps above.

<details><summary>Before (useNavigationSync.ts restored from origin/main 14208f2c), page type record</summary>

```text
PUT  /api/v1/meta/page/before_record_probe?mode=draft -> 200
POST /api/v1/meta/page/before_record_probe/publish    -> 200
PUT  /api/v1/meta/app/showcase_app                    -> 403
PUT  /api/v1/meta/app/probe_app                       -> 200
PUT  /api/v1/meta/app/rthree_app                      -> 200
toasts: success "Navigation updated: added page before_record_probe" · error "Failed to update navigation"
```

</details>

<details><summary>After (this branch), page type record, run twice (before and after the before-run's restore)</summary>

```text
PUT  /api/v1/meta/page/after_record_probe_two?mode=draft -> 200
POST /api/v1/meta/page/after_record_probe_two/publish    -> 200
toasts: none
```

</details>

<details><summary>After (this branch), page type home</summary>

```text
PUT  /api/v1/meta/page/after_home_probe_two?mode=draft -> 200
POST /api/v1/meta/page/after_home_probe_two/publish    -> 200
PUT  /api/v1/meta/app/probe_app                        -> 200
PUT  /api/v1/meta/app/rthree_app                       -> 200
toasts: success "Navigation updated: added page after_home_probe_two"
```

No write reaches `showcase_app`, `setup` or `account`, and no error toast shows.

</details>
